name.km: បាយឆាផ្សិត

description: Wok-tossed Khmer fried rice with mushroom.
descriptionKm: បាយឆា — ឆាក្ដៅជាមួយសាច់ បន្លែ និងពងមាន់។

ingredients.itemKm: បាយម្លិះកាល់ពីមួយថ្ងៃ
ខ្ទឹមបារាំង
ingredients.notesKm: កាត់ជាគូបតូច

ingredients.itemKm: ស្លឹកខ្ទឹមបារាំង
ទឹកសុីអ៊ីវស្រាល
ទឹកអយស្ទ័រ

instructions.text: Use cold, day-old rice and break up any clumps.
instructions.tip: Fresh rice turns mushy — day-old rice fries up separate and light.

instructions.text: Heat a wok very hot; fry the garlic, then the mushroom until softened and glossy.
Push aside and scramble the eggs.
Add the rice and onion; toss over high heat to coat and heat through.
Season with soy, oyster and fish sauces; toss until smoky and fragrant.
Finish with spring onion. Serve with sliced cucumber, lime and chili sauce.
